dataTable.groupingDescription: Grouped rows automatically render spanning headers with independent expansion and nested grouping. Customize header, footer, and direct-child preview limits with grouping; counts describe all matching leaf records. For per-group previews, set manualPagination: true and showPagination: false. See the Grouped Data Table block for show-more interactions.
dataTable.groupingOptions: Optional getLabel / getOrder / getRowLimit and renderHeader / renderFooter. Context includes row, table, leafRowCount, and visibleRowCount; labels localize expansion controls.
dataTable.groupingModel: Supply TanStack's grouping model and grouping state, with getExpandedRowModel for child expansion.
dataTable.density: Cell-density recipe applied to records and loading rows without resizing nested controls.
dataTable.bulkSelectionDescription: Selecting one or more rows replaces the search and filters with the current selection count and its available bulk actions. Clear the selection to restore the filter toolbar without losing its state.
dataTable.pinnedColumnsDescription: Scroll horizontally to see the first two columns remain fixed on the left and Budget remain fixed on the right.
dataTable.loadingStateDescription: Headers, column widths, pinned positioning, pagination, and the current page height remain stable while Skeleton rows replace the table body.
dataTable.controlLabels: Use DataTableColumnHeader.labels for ascending, descending, resetSorting and hideColumn menu copy; DataTableViewOptions.labels configures column settings. DataTableFacetedFilter.labels.clearFilters configures the clear action inside its popover. Omitted labels retain their English defaults.
dataTable.table: TanStack table instance returned by useDataTable.
dataTable.tableProps: Attributes for the semantic table, such as aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-busy, id, and className. Top-level DOM props still belong to the outer container. Table content, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, and the measurement ref cannot be replaced.
dataTable.activeRowId: TanStack row id highlighted as the current active row.
dataTable.onRowActivate: Activates a row by pointer, Enter, or Space without intercepting nested controls.
dataTable.children: Optional toolbar or custom content rendered above the table.
dataTable.actionBar: Selection actions shown when one or more filtered rows are selected.
dataTable.emptyStateContent: Custom Empty composition shown when the current row model has no rows.
dataTable.emptyMessage: Title used by the built-in Empty state. Active filters also add guidance and a clear-filter action.
dataTable.isLoading: Replaces data and empty rows with a column-aligned Skeleton body.
dataTable.loadingMessage: Accessible status announced while the table is loading.
dataTable.loadingRowCount: Number of placeholder rows shown while loading. Defaults to the current page size.
dataTable.paginationProps: Configures the built-in pagination region, including disabled state, labels, page-size options, and outer layout props.
dataTable.showPagination: Whether to render pagination controls. For a complete resource tree, set false and use manualPagination: true to keep all expanded rows visible.
dataTable.hierarchy: Supports getSubRows, getExpandedRowModel, state.expanded and onExpandedChange. Cells can indent by row.depth and use row.getToggleExpandedHandler(). See the Compute Resource Cost block for a complete example.
dataTable.renderLoadingCell: Customizes a loading cell using its row index, column index, and TanStack column.
dataTable.columns: Column definitions, headers, cells, and filter metadata.
dataTable.initialState: Initial sorting, pagination, visibility, and pinning state.
dataTable.options: Other TanStack Table options, including row selection and custom filter functions.
dataTable.label: Readable column label used by filters and view options.
dataTable.variant: Toolbar filter generated for this column.
dataTable.filterOptions: Options for select and multi-select filters. Each option may provide an authoritative count for server-side facets.
dataTable.placeholder: Placeholder for text and number filters.
dataTable.unit: Optional suffix displayed inside a number filter.
